Operations.Name: AppImageDelete
Operations.Description:
Delete docker image `image_id`.

`options.force` when set will force delete the image regardless of the state of containers and should
be used cautiously.

Arguments.Name: image_id
Arguments.Description: Container image ID or reference to delete.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Deletion options controlling force removal behavior.

Operations.Name: AppImageDockerhubRateLimit
Operations.Description:
Returns the current rate limit information for Docker Hub registry.

Please refer to https://docs.docker.com/docker-hub/download-rate-limit/ for more information.

Operations.Name: AppImageGetInstance
Operations.Description:
Returns instance matching `id`. If `id` is not found, Validation error is raised.

Please see `query` method documentation for `options`.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Query options customize the results returned by a query method. More complete documentation with examples     are covered in the "Query methods" section of the TrueNAS API documentation.

Operations.Name: AppImagePull
Operations.Description:
`image` is the name of the image to pull. Format for the name is "registry/repo/image:v1.2.3" where
registry may be omitted and it will default to docker registry in this case. It can or cannot contain
the tag - this will be passed as is to docker so this should be analogous to what `docker pull` expects.

`auth_config` should be specified if image to be retrieved is under a private repository.

Operations.Name: AppImageQuery
Operations.Description:
Query all docker images with `query-filters` and `query-options`.

`query-options.extra.parse_tags` is a boolean which when set will have normalized tags to be retrieved.

Arguments.Name: filters
Arguments.Description: List of filters for query results. See API documentation for "Query Methods" for more guidance.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Query options including pagination, ordering, and additional parameters.

Fields.Name: Password
Fields.Description: Password or access token for container registry authentication.

Fields.Name: RegistryUri
Fields.Description: Container registry URI or `null` to use default registry.

Fields.Name: Username
Fields.Description: Username for container registry authentication.

Fields.Name: Error
Fields.Description: Error message if rate limit information could not be retrieved or `null` on success.

Fields.Name: RemainingPullLimit
Fields.Description: Remaining pull limit for Docker Hub registry.

Fields.Name: RemainingTimeLimitInSecs
Fields.Description: Remaining time limit in seconds for Docker Hub registry for the current pull limit to be renewed.

Fields.Name: TotalPullLimit
Fields.Description: Total pull limit for Docker Hub registry.

Fields.Name: TotalTimeLimitInSecs
Fields.Description: Total time limit in seconds for Docker Hub registry before the limit renews.

Models.Name: AppImageGetInstanceOptions
Models.Description: Query options customize the results returned by a query method. More complete documentation with examples     are covered in the "Query methods" section of the TrueNAS API documentation.

Fields.Name: Extra
Fields.Description: Extra options are defined on a per-endpoint basis and are described in the documentation for the associated     query method.

Fields.Name: ForceSqlFilters
Fields.Description: Force use of SQL for result filtering to reduce response time. May not work for all methods.

Fields.Name: Limit
Fields.Description:
This specifies the maximum number of results matching the specified `query-filters` to return. When     combined wtih the `offset` query-option it may be used to implement pagination of large results arrays.

WARNING: Some query methods provide volatile results and the onus is on the developer to understand whether     pagination is appropriate for a particular query API method.

Fields.Name: Offset
Fields.Description: This specifies the beginning offset of the results array. When combined with the `limit` query-option     it may be used to implement pagination of large results arrays. WARNING: some query methods provide     volatile results and the onus is on the developer to understand whether pagination is appropriate     for a particular query API method.

Fields.Name: OrderBy
Fields.Description: An array of field names describing the manner in which query results should be ordered. The field names may     also have one of more of the following special prefixes: `-` (reverse sort direction), `nulls_first:` (place     any null values at the head of the results list), `nulls_last:` (place any null values at the tail of the     results list).

Fields.Name: Select
Fields.Description: An array of field names specifying the exact fields to include in the query return. The dot character `.`     may be used to explicitly select only subkeys of the query result.

Fields.Name: CompleteTag
Fields.Description: Complete image reference including registry, image name, and tag.

Fields.Name: Image
Fields.Description: Container image name without registry or tag.

Fields.Name: Reference
Fields.Description: Full reference to the container image (registry/repository:tag).

Fields.Name: ReferenceIsDigest
Fields.Description: Whether the reference uses a digest hash instead of a tag name.

Fields.Name: Registry
Fields.Description: Container registry hostname (e.g., docker.io, quay.io).

Fields.Name: Tag
Fields.Description: Image tag (version) or digest identifier.
